SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: SELECT TOP 500 H.DOCTYP [SRCTYP] ,H.DOCNUM [SRCDOC] ,S.DOCLIN [SRCLIN] ,H.DOCNUM + '-' + Cast(S.DOCLIN AS VARCHAR) PORKEY ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), H.DOCDAT, 23) DOCDAT ,H.DOCDES ,H.PRJNUM ,H.SITE ,SITEDES.SITENAM SITEDES ,H.BPSNO ,BPS.BPSNAM ,H.CUR ,S.ITMNO ,ITM.ITMNAM + ITM.ITMNAM1 + ITM.ITMNAM2 ITMNAM ,ITM.ITMSPEC ,ITM.ITMSIZE ,S.ITMVER ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.REQDAT, 23) REQDAT ,S.STU --库存单位 ,Iif(ITM.TCLCOD = 'FIBER', ITM.PCU, S.UOM) UOM --采购单位 ,S.UOMCOE --换算系数 ,S.QTYSTU - Isnull(PBO.QTYSTU, 0) QTYSTU--库存单位数量 ,Isnull(PBO.QTYSTU, 0) PBOQTYSTU ,Isnull(PBO.QTY, 0) PBOQTY ,S.IVATTYP ,S.PRCQTYSTU ,S.PRTQTYSTU ,S.NETPRI PORNETPRI ,S.NETPRI ,S.GROPRI ,S.TAXRT ,S.NETAMT ,S.TAXAMT ,H.CONTNOI --百隆合同号 ,H.CONTNOE --合同号 ,H.CONTDES ,S.GRPAMT ,S.SRCTYP [ORITYP] ,S.SRCDOC [ORIDOC] ,S.SRCLIN [ORILIN] ,S.FAC ,CASE WHEN H.CUR = '{6}' THEN '1' ELSE '' END CHOOSEFLG FROM PORDER H INNER JOIN PORDLIN S ON H.DOCNUM = S.DOCNUM INNER JOIN BPSUP BPS ON H.BPSNO = BPS.BPSNO INNER JOIN ITM ON ITM.ITMNO = S.ITMNO LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCSTA ON DOCSTA.OPTID = H.DOCSTA AND DOCSTA.OPTTYP = 'DOCSTA' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT LDOCSTA ON LDOCSTA.OPTID = S.DOCSTA AND LDOCSTA.OPTTYP = 'DOCSTA' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT WFLSTA ON WFLSTA.OPTID = H.WFLSTA AND WFLSTA.OPTTYP = 'WFLSTA' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT IVATTYP ON IVATTYP.OPTID = S.IVATTYP AND IVATTYP.OPTTYP = 'IVATTYP' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCGRP ON DOCGRP.OPTID = H.DOCGRP AND DOCGRP.OPTTYP = 'DOCGRP' AND DOCGRP.LINKOPTID = 'POH' LEFT JOIN ENTSITE SITEDES ON SITEDES.SITE = H.SITE LEFT JOIN (SELECT SRCDOC ,SRCLIN ,Sum(QTYSTU) QTYSTU ,Sum(QTY) QTY FROM PBOLD GROUP BY SRCDOC ,SRCLIN) PBO ON PBO.SRCDOC = S.DOCNUM AND PBO.SRCLIN = S.DOCLIN WHERE S.DOCSTA = '2' AND ( ITM.TCLCOD = 'FIBER' OR S.QTYSTU - Isnull(PBO.QTYSTU, 0) > 0 ) --纤维原料提单数量会超订单数不做控制 AND H.SITE LIKE '%{0}%' AND H.BPSNO = '{1}' AND H.CONTNOI + H.CONTNOE + H.DOCNUM LIKE '%{2}%' AND S.ITMNO LIKE '%{3}%' AND S.ITMVER LIKE '%{4}%' AND H.DOCNUM + ITM.ITMNAM + ITM.ITMNAM1 + ITM.ITMNAM2 + ITM.ITMSPEC + ITM.ITMSIZE LIKE '%{5}%' --AND ITM.ITMSIZE LIKE '%{6}%' --AND ITM.ITMSPEC LIKE '%{7}%' ORDER BY REQDAT DESC
